description: Welcome to MoneyLine Apparel Co., where passion for gambling meets style! We’re two college students with a shared love for the thrill of the game and an even greater passion for making it look good. While we enjoy the excitement of betting, we believe that every gambler should feel confident and stylish while doing it.

1. Definitions and Acceptance

By applying to or participating in our Affiliate Program, you accept and agree to these Terms & Conditions and any future revisions. We may offer your affiliate account in our internal dashboard or via an affiliate network.

  • “Affiliate Link / Code”: a unique identifier or URL that tracks sales from your referrals.

  • “Qualifying Purchase”: sale of our products tracked through your Affiliate Link, minus refunds, chargebacks, misorders, returns, tax, shipping, and discounts not issued by us.

2. Enrollment & Eligibility

  • Approval of your application may take up to 7 business days, and we reserve the right to cancel your application at any time.

  • Once approved, we will provide login credentials or designate your Affiliate Link.


3. Commissions & Payment

  • Tracking & Cookies: Standard 30-day cookie applies (other period may be specified). Only the last click qualifies. Self-referrals or spam-triggered purchases are void.

  • Returns/Refunds: Qualifying Purchases are validated 30 days post-sale; only non-refunded/non-returned purchases count for commission.

  • Payment Threshold & Schedule: Minimum balance for payout is 15% of total cart value. Payments are made monthly on or before the next month via PayPal or bank transfer. We reserve the right to hold payment for manual review.


4. Disclosure Requirements (FTC & Global)

Sample Affiliate Disclosure Language for Your Site/Content (non-contract):
